name: hcportal_getTimezonesForGeography
description: Returns the distinct timezones used by cities in a given country (optionally narrowed to a region). Powers the manual timezone dropdown shown when a run's location is entered as free text ('Other' region/city) with no structured city to derive a timezone from. Device-bound portal auth via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth; any signed-in portal user. Only live cities (Removed = 0) that belong to a region of the country are considered.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Auth: device ID used to look up the authenticated user and device secret. Validated via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Auth: short-lived cryptographic token validated via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth.

parameters.name: countryId
parameters.description: Filter: only timezones used by cities in this country are returned. Not validated — NULL returns an empty rowset. Matched against Region.CountryId.

parameters.name: regionId
parameters.description: Optional filter: when provided, narrows the result to timezones used by cities in this region.

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: Returned on auth failure (HC6.ValidatePortalAuth message) or from the CATCH block (ERROR_MESSAGE()).

rowsets.name: TimezonesForGeographyResult
rowsets.description: Distinct timezones used by cities in the geography, ordered by displayName. Empty if the geography has no cities/timezones.

columns.name: ianaTimeZone
columns.description: IANA zone name, e.g. 'Europe/London' (may be null)

columns.name: utcOffset
columns.description: Standard-time offset hint (the smaller of the 1 Jan / 1 Jul offsets this year, via AT TIME ZONE on DomainValues.Timezone.Timezone), formatted 'UTC+HH:MM' / 'UTC-HH:MM'.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning

codeSmells.issue: CATCH block does not log to HC.ErrorLog
codeSmells.detail: Lines 83-86: CATCH returns the envelope without an HC.ErrorLog row.
The header calls @countryId required, but nothing checks it; NULL simply returns no rows.
